text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit parking at all times on the east side of Bunnell Crescent, between Nash Drive and Hallsport Crescent. The proposed parking prohibitions will address the concerns of the residents on Bunnell Crescent regarding the safe flow of two-way traffic.
North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the east side of Bunnell Crescent, between Nash Drive and Hallsport Crescent.
